title: Fantasy Football Last Place Flag - Funny Loser Punishment
description:
Product overview
- Printed phrase (exact, do not alter):
  Eyebrow: SEASON RESULTS
  Line 1: LAST PLACE IN
  Line 2: FANTASY FOOTBALL
  Footer: WORST TEAM IN THE LEAGUE
- Intent: A direct last-place fantasy football label in a bright blue treatment, made for draft parties, toilet-bowl punishments, end-of-season humiliation, and league gag gifting.

Verified product facts
- Double-sided print (same design on both faces).
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor display.
- Printed to order.
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included.

Production and listing disclosure
- This listing and layout were created with AI-assisted design and copy help.
- Final printing and fulfillment are handled by our production partner, Blue Peak Prints.

Why this flag
Bold, funny, and unapologetic — this bright-blue flag calls out the league loser in a way that’s perfect for draft night, a watch party, the loser’s office, or any end-of-season ceremony. It’s loud enough to be noticed, cheeky enough to be shared, and double-sided so the humiliation is visible from either direction.

How buyers use it
- Hang it at draft parties or award nights to announce the definitive result.
- Display it at the loser’s home, office, or next watch party as a good-natured reminder.
- Use it as a gag gift or permanent “award” for the manager with the worst record.

Custom & ordering notes
- Each flag is printed to order; allow production time before shipping.
- If you need a larger quantity for multiple leagues or an alternate color treatment, message us to discuss options.

Please note
- This item is a novelty punishment product intended for adults in fantasy-football leagues. No flagpole or mounting hardware is included with the flag.
rationale: Design choices: Collegiate style with a bright-blue palette gives a bold, athletic look that reads clearly from a distance and pairs with fantasy-football party themes. Large, condensed uppercase typography emphasizes the confessionary, mock-award tone; an eyebrow line (SEASON RESULTS) and footer (WORST TEAM IN THE LEAGUE) frame the primary two-line message for instant clarity.
